brief:
Israeli soldiers descended from a helicopter onto a residential building in Yatta, in the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera English reported. The operation involved troops rappelling onto the roof of the structure in what appeared to be a raid or arrest operation.

Details of the specific purpose of the military maneuver and whether there were casualties or detentions remained unclear.
dek: Israeli forces rappelled from a helicopter onto the roof of a residential building in Yatta, in the occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli forces rappel onto West Bank residential building
